text:
Amelia V: Heads up — PR #10912 (kv-cache backfill) is green but blocked: needs 2x LGTM before tonight's cutover (t-60m). I'm +1 but need one more.
Raj P: I'm on PTO from 5pm PT so I can't be the second reviewer. Can someone pick up as a stand-in? If not we should delay cutover.
Marcus L: I can take a second look, but I need the minimal smoke checklist. What's the smallest set of checks to be comfortable?
Amelia V: Minimal smoke: deploy to canary, run `scripts/smoke_kv.sh` against canary, confirm p95 latency delta <20ms, run `curl /health` and check error-rate <0.1%. Also ensure no config change beyond the kv flag.
Marcus L: Got it. Kicking off canary deploy now. Sasha T tagging for config signoff.
Sasha T: Quick check on config: no new toggles except `kv_backfill_enabled`. I ran a dry-run locally earlier — looks safe. :eyes:
CI-bot: PR 10912 — Checks passed: unit ✅, integration ✅, e2e ✅, lint ✅. Coverage: unchanged.
Marcus L: Canary smoke run output: `p95 baseline 78ms -> canary 92ms` (delta 14ms) — within threshold. `curl https://canary.redwood/api/health` -> 200, no errors in logs from warmup.
Marcus L: LGTM :shipit: (leaving a short review comment with smoke logs)
Amelia V: Thanks Marcus — that's one more approval. We still need one additional LGTM to meet policy. Raj is OOO. Any other volunteers?
Sasha T: I can +1 from the config/ops side — I've reviewed the flag, smoke looks clean. Adding my approval now. LGTM.
Amelia V: Awesome. Please set `merge_on_cutoff: true` in the PR so deploy-bot can queue it. I'll coordinate timing.
deploy-bot: Noted. Cutover window scheduled for 2026-03-18T22:00:00Z. Will queue merge at t-15m if 2x LGTM present.
Amelia V: Backup plan: if we don't have 2x LGTM by t-15m, we autoschedule a rollback of the canary and hold the cutover for +2h. Sounds OK?
Raj P: Thanks for the handoff — appreciate the cover. If anything needs my eyes tomorrow morning PT, ping me and I'll jump in.
Amelia V: Merge policy satisfied; merging now per rotation and approvals. PR merged at 2026-03-18T21:45:10Z. :tada:
deploy-bot: Deploy started: canary -> stable. Monitor: https://console.redwood/inference/deploys/10912
Marcus L: Watching logs — no errors in canary for 10m. :heavy_check_mark:
Sasha T: Observability shows no CPU or latency regressions post-merge. Rolling forward looks safe.
Amelia V: Thanks team — closing this thread. I'll add a short note in the release doc about the approver handoff and the smoke checklist.
